recordedBefore: the release benchmark; recorded after A8 reached 50 of 55 (90.9%), raising the bar, never lowering it
status: Felipe's bar (2026-10-12, binding): 'make sure it's at least 97. That's what we're waiting for.' Lower bound and sample size remain Claude's proposal, Felipe to confirm.
scope: Everything that sets a founder's status (Exposed or At risk): deterministic findings and the customer agent's admitted findings, as rendered, on a held-out set frozen before the change being measured. INFO facts are reported, not gated.

definitions.truePositive: both blind labelers agree the statement as written is accurate AND the issue is real against the deployed app
definitions.falsePositive: anything else, including partly accurate and contested (disagreement counts against us)
definitions.precision: TP / (TP + FP), with a one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound

statusSetting.note: With 100 labeled findings, 97% observed means at most 3 false, and the one-sided 95% lower bound is then about 92.4%; the 85% bound is no longer the binding constraint.

statusCorrectness.note: Exposed or At risk is right when at least one issue setting it is a true positive; No open issues is reported with what was unread.

reportedNotGated: recall on named known vulnerabilities (misses listed by name)
